rationale: Spend a small amount of the remaining 16MB export budget on the missing value projection in the penultimate recurrent tail block. The current best already keeps tail projections plus recurrent-tail Q/K and final-block V in fp16; this makes both recurrent tail blocks full QKV while deleting the now-redundant final-block V special case. It does not alter training throughput, validation, tokenizer paths, or the final int8+zlib roundtrip path.
title: Additive Recurrent-Tail QKV FP16 Rescue
